BD7B.name: service_loop
doc: Service mode loop: the service coin starts the cross hatch, which
stays until the service coin is pressed AGAIN ($BD8A waits for bit
3 of $6800 to come back); service switch off -> reset_main;
otherwise a change of switch nibble 0-2 steps the sound test
($100A) and plays it, nibble 3 only plays it.
